description: Java class for deserializing and validating JSON API requests related to 'code' entities, supporting create and update operations.

classes.name: CodeCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component that provides methods to validate JSON input for creating and updating 'code' entities, ensuring required fields are present and conform to constraints.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a 'code' entity, checking for unsupported parameters and validating the 'name' field.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a 'code' entity, conditionally validating the 'name' field if present.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are accumulated during validation.
